run_CLIP_training: run the main training loop for a CLIP model using a config file and optional checkpoint resume
run_random_seed: run random_seed to set reproducible seeds for torch, numpy, and python random with a given seed and rank
run_create_model_and_transforms: run create_model_and_transforms to build a CLIP model and train/val preprocessing transforms with precision and device settings
run_load_checkpoint: run load_checkpoint to resume training from a saved checkpoint file restoring model, optimizer, and scaler state
run_cosine_lr: run cosine_lr to create a cosine learning rate scheduler with warmup steps for the optimizer
